displayed_text:
Per the handbook's notice table, where service is 2 years or more notice is one week per completed year of service—so after three years you give three weeks' notice (the policy also notes this is subject to any statutory maximum).

Before leaving, follow the HR exit process: provide notice as above; return any Alderbridge property and issued equipment (including keys or access cards and any devices); HR will make a final pay calculation and issue a final payslip reflecting any outstanding holiday pay; and, where you agree, participate in an exit interview. Also ensure any required IT account/device steps per the Password and Account Access and Mobile Device Management guidance are followed and that references or verification requests are handled via HR per the Staff Reference Request Procedure.
